data.gender_notes: Alicio is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Alicio is derived from the Latin word 'alicius', meaning 'defender' or 'protector of the people'. It is a name of noble and heroic origin, with strong connotations of bravery and leadership. The name Alicio carries the meaning “Defender of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alicio usually hope their child will grow to embody defender of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: אליציו
in_hebrew.meaning: אליציו הוא שם שפירושו האל הוא ישועתי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אליציו הוא שם שמקורו בשורשים עבריים ופירושו 'האל הוא ישועתי' או 'אלוהים הוא ישועתי'. השם אליציו נגזר מהמילים העבריות 'אל' שפירושו אלוהים ו'יצו' שפירושו ישועתי. השם מופיע בשינויים שונים בכתבי הקודש ומשמש כזכר לחסדו וישועתו של האל.

in_greek.name: Αλίτσιος
in_greek.meaning: Αλίτσιος σημαίνει Ο Θεός είναι η σωτηρία μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αλίτσιος προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές ρίζες και σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι η σωτηρία μου' ή 'Ο Θεός είναι ο σωτήρας μου'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοια ονόματα συνδέονται με τη σχέση μεταξύ του ανθρώπου και του Θεού, εκφράζοντας την πίστη και την εμπιστοσύνη στο Θεό ως τον μοναδικό σωτήρα.

data.cultural_impact: The name Alicio has a rich cultural history, particularly within the Christian tradition. This name became synonymous with the idea of a defender of the faith and the people, and was often bestowed upon those who held positions of power and influence within the community. In this way, the name Alicio served as a symbol of the virtues celebrated by the Christian faith.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Alicio carries the profound meaning of a protector and defender of the faith and the people. In the Christian tradition, this name embodies the idea of living a life of devotion to God and inspiring others to do the same. It is a reminder of the importance of standing up for what is good and right, and protecting those who are vulnerable or in need. Ultimately, the name Alicio is a call to live a life of courage, strength, and selflessness, in imitation of Christ who laid down his life for the salvation of mankind.

historical_references.reference: The name Alicio is derived from the Hebrew name Elisha, which means 'my God is salvation'. In the 6th century, a renowned Christian bishop named Adeodatus had a son named Alicio who became the Bishop of Oviedo in northern Spain in 589 AD.

During the Middle Ages in Europe, the name Alicio gained popularity and was often given to boys born into noble families. One such notable figure was Alicio de Borgoña, who was born in the late 11th century. He was a Spanish knight and the Count of Barcelona from 1096 to 1137 AD.
